results.title: Rishikanta Singh Wins Silver Medal at Commonwealth Games 2026 in Men's 60kg Weightlifting
results.description: Indian weightlifter Rishikanta Singh, 28, clinched a silver medal in the Men's 60kg category at the Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games on July 26. Singh delivered a new Commonwealth Games and national snatch record of 121kg and a total lift of 264kg, securing India's second medal of the Games. This significant achievement highlights his consistent performance.
